Done — the aquatic update is fully built. Here's the summary:

## What I recommended and built

You asked for next-feature recommendations. My top pick was an **aquatic update** (the ocean your new rafts and ships sail was empty — nothing to see, nothing to sail to), with runner-ups being a deferred-mechanics batch, a Nether-style dimension, and redstone-lite. The plan question timed out, so I proceeded with the recommended option after you approved the plan.

It's complete on the local branch `feat/aquatic-update` — **5 commits, not pushed** (per your review-first workflow):

1. **Kelp & coral** — swaying kelp stalks and pink/blue reef coral on the sandy ocean floor. Kelp keeps a 3-block clear-water band so boats never snag, regrows via random ticks, harvests as a full stalk (refilling with water, never air pockets), and smelts 3-at-a-time into dried kelp.
2. **Cod & salmon** — the first water-dwelling mobs, with a dedicated 3D swim/flee AI branch that can never leave water, a legless fish model variant, and an aquatic spawn director so oceans you sail to are stocked (zero fish on Superflat — the sampler fails closed).
3. **Shipwrecks** — flooded plank hulls sunk on the deep ocean floor with 1–2 loot chests of nautical salvage. The dungeon lazy-fill system generalized to per-family loot tables and seed constants.
4. **Buried treasure & the treasure map** — loot a map from a wreck (40%) or fish one up, follow a compass HUD to the beach, dig two blocks under the sand for the richest chest in the game. The map is stateless (compass derives from the seed, retargets after each dig), plus minimap X marks and an "X Marks the Spot" advancement.
5. **Docs** — manual, reference, tuning, adding-content, testing, save-format, CHANGELOG, and README all updated (including two stale version numbers I found in tuning.md).

## Impact & verification

- **`WORLDGEN_VERSION` 9→10** (old worlds reboot from their seed, digests re-baselined per policy); **save schema stays v16** — no migration needed.
- Full gate green at every commit: lint, typecheck, format, **984 unit tests** (35 new), build, and **18/18 Playwright e2e**.

## What's left for you

- **A manual gameplay pass** on an ocean seed (kelp/coral/fish visuals, wreck diving, compass feel, bubble SFX) — the wolf/cat spawn bug taught us not to skip this before a release.
- Review the 5 commits, then tell me to push / open the PR when you're happy.
